hypothesis: Five-bit bank flags let a nine-word lookup fit the width cap and lower complete chemistry cost with unchanged numeric inputs.
parameter_ranges: Reference J8 rebuild, naive J9 width-negative control, and one banked J9 family with seven low bits.
correctness_conditions: Exact recovered words and factorization bytes, zero padding, preserved selection and phase, zero workspace after every circuit, and at most 128 qubits.
objective: Measured complete official chemistry cost on the same numerical inputs.
stop_rule: Stop on reference mismatch, a failed invariant, budget exhaustion, or measured gain below 2 percent.
